title: unified-rollouts-canary-shadow-autorollback-add-safety-guards
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: production canary and shadow rollouts occasionally triggered automated rollbacks during short-lived telemetry blips and upstream rate anomalies. This PR adds safety guards to the unified rollouts autorollback engine to reduce false-positive rollbacks while preserving fast failure for genuine regressions. Changes: 1) add quorum-based metric aggregation: require N out of M metrics to breach thresholds before triggering rollback; 2) add sustained-window check: a metric breach must persist for configurable time window before action; 3) add autoscaling/backpressure detection: if cluster autoscaling or rate limit spikes are detected, postpone rollback and escalate to a probe/quarantine stage; 4) add manual-quarantine workflow to allow on-call to quarantine and probe without full rollback; 5) extend observability: new rollout-level metrics (rollback_decision_reason, quarantine_count, sustained_breach_seconds) and tracing spans for decision paths; 6) add e2e and unit tests and update rollouts docs. Implementation notes: introduces a new SafetyGate interface with implementations for QuorumGate, SustainedWindowGate, and ExternalSignalGate. Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains unchanged unless the rollout policy includes safety_gate configuration. Config schema bump documented. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration tests in perf-canary - [x] e2e tests for canary/shadow scenarios - [x] observability dashboards updated - [x] feature-flagged rollout for gradual rollout Rollout of this change: gated behind feature flag rollout.safety_guards and will be enabled by default for internal staging clusters for 48h before org-wide rollout. Migration: operators can opt-in via policy update, no mandatory migrations required. Related: addresses noise seen in SUP-2198 incident and complements ENG-4521 work on quorum metrics.
